newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Kian Ho in 1-for-5 bonus, warrants issue.
newsitem.headline: Kian Ho in 1-for-5 bonus, warrants issue.

text.p: Kian Ho Bearings Ltd said on Friday it planned to list 26 million new shares of Singapore $0.10 on the Stock Exchange of Singapore in a one-for-five bonus issue.
Kian Ho also said in a statement it planned to issue 26 million warrants in conjunction with a transferable loan facility of Singapore $25 million.
Kian Ho said a good performance in the year to December 31, 1996, in which it recorded net profits of S$5.11 against S$4.65 previously, had justified the bonus issue.
The statement added that the resultant increase in the company's capital base would enable the firm to develop its plans for growth and expansion.
The firm said S$15 million of the loan facility would be used to build a warehouse with the balance used for working capital and to refinance bank borrowings.
Kian Ho said the bonus shares would rank pari passu in all respects with existing ordinary shares, except they would not qualify for participation in the warrant offer.
The warrants would also be offered on a one-for-five basis.
Kian Ho said the issues and the loan, to be approved by the SES and shareholders, would be handled by the Development Bank of Singapore Ltd.
